sections.description: Narrow, logged abilities for Blue Collar Marketing's Claude workflows.
sections.changelog:
1.3.3

Marker.io feedback widget as a known tracking service; `bcm/remove-tracking-code`; Marker.io comment attachments allowed as an image source (Marker.io's attachment storage only); add/remove images in galleries and carousels, including inside tabs of tabbed galleries; add gallery tabs.

1.3.2

element-only find/replace (`element_ids`); add/remove items in widget lists (icon lists, FAQs, price lists) including classic widgets; WordPress menu editing; image swaps carry over alt text; update checks every 2 hours plus `bcm/check-for-updates`.

1.3.1

find and swap images in Elementor (classic, backgrounds, Atomic); list Media Library images; client-friendly plugin description.

1.3.0

find and replace across Elementor (classic, containers, Atomic), theme-builder templates and posts, with phone-number mode; list Elementor forms and change where they send (business email auto-detected, submitter thank-you never changed).

1.2.4

cache purge now requires Editor or higher; uninstall keeps the activity log unless BCM_AGENCY_DELETE_LOG_ON_UNINSTALL is set.
